# Security Policy

## Supported versions

This is a reference/showcase project. Only the latest release on `main` receives fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security issues **privately** via GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/aoreshkov/kmp-ledger/security/advisories/new)
(repository **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**).

Do not open public issues for security problems. We aim to acknowledge reports within a few days.
Thank you for helping keep the project secure.
